ios.desc:
NoteSub brings radical simplicity to note-taking with five essential note types that match how you naturally think. Best of all, it is  designed to make your notes as enjoyable as scrolling through your social feeds.  

Why You'll Love NoteSub
Local Notes First - Your True Second Brain 
Eight note types so you can be in control:
- Text for thoughts and ideas
- Image notes for visual memories
- Voice recordings for quick capture
- Database Notes for structured information
- Todo Lists for actionable items
- Kanban boards for visual project management
- Weekly planners for time organization
- Drawings 

Distraction-Free Design Clean interface with beautiful typography

Your Data Stays Yours
- Local storage by default—notes stay on your device
- No NoteSub account required, no data collection.
- iCloud sync available as in-app purchase to access notes across your Apple devices (via iCloud Sync, devices need to be signed in to the same account)
- Full offline functionality
- Search across notes with Tags

Made for Mobile 
Built iOS-first with native performance, Apple Pencil integration on the iPad, and intuitive touch interactions optimized for iPhone and iPad.

Perfect For
Students: Capture notes quickly without setup overhead. Keep personal journals private. Plan your week. 
Professionals: Manage projects with simple Kanban boards. Organise take homes from meetings.
Creatives: Sketch ideas and dump visuals. Gorgeous Notes Feed. 
Anyone who values privacy: Keep your thoughts local and secure, with optional iCloud sync. We do not collect your data.

What Makes NoteSub Different
- While other apps try to do everything, NoteSub excels at the fundamentals: capturing thoughts quickly, organizing them simply, and finding them easily.
- No complex structures  to configure. No paid for templates to choose from. No overwhelming feature lists. Just beautiful, private note-taking that respects your time and attention.

Download NoteSub and rediscover the joy of simple, powerful note-taking.

Features:
- Eight versatile note types (Text, Image, Voice, Database, Todo List, Kanban, Weekly, Drawing)
- Voice recording capabilities
- Structured database notes
- Offline search
- Local storage (with iCloud sync available as in-app purchase)
- Beautiful, distraction-free design
- Native iOS performance

quotes.text:
I tried to make a way of sharing posts with friends without having to be on a social network... I came up with NoteSub:

https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/notesub/id6742334239

I like it. And mass adaption is not required to use it.

I would have loved to have made this a true social network in some regards, however, there are issues of moderation and storage that become very expensive at scale.

Moreover, adoption of a new social network is super hard to promote. So many Twitter, Insta, etc clones have failed because they are just 'clones'. Not offering any thing new.

It should be considered although Thiel talks of 0 to 1... A great deal of dramatic software/hardware progression comes from a highly evolved successor to an average pre-existing product.

The iPhone was not a zero to one, nor was Apples GUI, they were just highly evolved versions of average or below average products that already existed. Social media apps are already highly evolved for their function. We need something better for edge cases, but the current state of social media platforms means that something supremely better is required before any adoption drive becomes meaningful. When such a product comes, mass adoption is inevitable; we crave and succumb to better ways of communication and contact.

I believe that the more populist layer of the www became social media apps. Hosted LLMs (claude, chatGPT etc) are going to become the popular source of information and therefore narrative. What
we must remember is that we should retain control of our thoughts, and be aware of how we can share them without financially
interested parties claiming rights to their use or abuse. I am trying to solve some of these problems with NoteSub App - https://apps.apple.com/gb/app/notesub/id6742334239 - but have yet to overcome the real issue of how we can stop the middleman keeping the loop closed with him in between.
